name: ANSI/IEEE normally closed pushbutton symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for normally closed pushbutton, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The momentary NC pushbutton form describes a normally continuous path opened by the operator. Its circuit role can be stop, inhibit or another command, but that purpose comes from the wiring and label rather than from NC alone.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Evaluate the path before, during and after operation.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: An NC contact form does not by itself identify a complete emergency-stop safety circuit.
